newsitem.title: UK: Bensons, W T Foods reach deal on tortilla chips.
newsitem.headline: Bensons, W T Foods reach deal on tortilla chips.

text.p: Bensons Crisps Plc and WT Foods Plc said on Monday they had entered into a royalty agreement for the manufacture and sale of La Mexicana brand and private label Tortilla Chips.
Bensons has planned investment in new plant to make base Tortilla Chips, the company said, which are currently supplied by WT Foods' La Mexicana unit.
The new plant will by buying in flour and baking tortillas, which Bensons said it believed made "better economic sense."
By freeing up capacity dedicated to Bensons business, WT Foods will be able to increase its share of the Mexican food market and develop new products.
WT Foods interest in the snack food market will be maintained through the royalty agreement, the companies said in a statement.
